title: Lob
description: Artillery for two people and one phone. Two tanks at opposite ends of a landscape that really does blow apart: set an angle and a power, pick one of eight single-use weapons and fire. Shells arc under gravity and a crosswind, bite craters out of the ground and drop a tank that loses the dirt beneath it. Both control decks sit on screen at once, each rotated to face its own end of the table, and only the deck whose turn it is lights up. Rollers run downhill, Augers drill shafts, Skyfall calls in seven bombs, Bulwark builds a wall instead of shooting. No trajectory preview: fire, watch, correct.
